name: 랜턴
scene: On a quiet ocean-breakwater platform under clear early morning light, balanced upright card stance, face toward camera, both empty open hands relaxed beside her hips and away from the torso.

casual.scene: At a secluded rocky hot-spring basin at misty dawn, perched on a smooth dry stone ledge, lowering one hand to test the water while the other rests open on the ledge. Cool mist and warm low sunlight, both hands visible.
casual.outfit: Fully lined opaque teal asymmetrical one-piece swimsuit with one broad shoulder strap, secure neckline, small side waist cutout and full intimate coverage. Bare arms, side waist and legs; tiny amber orb bracelet, no armor.

casual.scene: In an airy traditional textile workshop at midday, standing upright and unfolding a small piece of hand-dyed blue silk between two clearly separated hands below her face. Wooden lattice window, pale daylight, no signage or other people.
casual.outfit: Contemporary heritage-inspired indigo sleeveless wrap top with secure cross-over neckline and white wide-legged linen trousers below crop. Bare arms shoulders and small side-waist gap, one tiny amber bead pendant.

casual.scene: In an empty seaside kite meadow in golden evening light, mid-step and gently turning toward camera while guiding the thin line of a small plain kite overhead. The kite stays in the distant background, both hands at waist height, complete body and shoes visible.
casual.outfit: Opaque pale-yellow sleeveless buttoned romper with tailored shorts and broad waist tie, simple blue canvas sandals. Bare shoulders arms and legs, tiny orb earrings, no armor.
